Nice, that's a solid unit. What can I help with, the ship date on it or something with the miner itself? If it's the order, give me the order number and the name or postcode ····I'll pull it up.
when it should arrive Order Shop····, Gabe

Looked something up in Shopify

Got it, Gabe. Your Magic Miner 40T ships October 31, 2026, along with the Harlo OS diagnostics line on the same order. Nothing has shipped yet, and the order is paid. Tracking goes to the email on the order as soon as it leaves the warehouse.
so i should have a tracking number on October 31, 2026 how long do you think it will take to get to my address when it ships like 5 days?

Tracking hits your inbox when it leaves the warehouse around that date. For a US address like Gilman, domestic ground is usually a few business days once it's moving, so under a week is normal, but the carrier's own estimate on the tracking page is the one to trust. I won't put a firm number on it before it ships.
ok thx
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)

Anytime, Gabe. Enjoy the 40T when it lands.

Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Harlo OS diagnostics and RMA cover to the order?
it was free and the OS Looks good from all the videos i see it in
Makes sense. Before I let you go: which videos were those, and is that where you first came across the Magic Miner?

i think i first seen it from The H. Miner. I have been looking to get into solo mining for fun for about 2 or 3 months and the price to TH/s was verry good i dont think i will buy anything like the Biteaxe 1.2 TH/s for $94 seems pricey for what you get
Fair read, the 40T is about the best per TH we sell. Last one, then I'll leave you be: are you thinking about running more than one unit, or is the 40T it for now?
Im probably going to get another one or maby Cannan Avalon Q 90TH/s looks good too i would be mining BCH better odds

The Avalon Q isn't one we recommend, so I'd point you at a second 40T or the Harlo B30 instead. Worth knowing BCH is SHA-256 too, so your 40T can point at a BCH pool through Harlo OS whenever you want, no new hardware needed. Want me to run the numbers for a second 40T at your (address hidden) rate?
sure
Ran the power-cost calculator

Gabe, these are for (address hidden) at Wisconsin's average 17.5 cents a kWh, today's BTC price and difficulty.

A second Magic Miner 40T stacks about 57,750 sats a month, worth roughly $48, and burns about $83 in power. Break-even BTC price is around $143,700. Solo block odds about 1 in 165,000 a day, roughly 0.22% over a year.

A Harlo B30 ($899, 30 TH/s, 405 W) stacks about 43,300 sats for about $52 power, break-even near $119,400.

At your rate the B30 loses less. If you know your real per kWh rate, tell me and I'll rerun it.
how about BCH
Ran the power-cost calculator

I only have BTC numbers from our calculator, so I won't guess BCH earnings for you. What I can say plainly: the hardware and the power cost don't change, about $83 a month for a 40T at your rate. BCH network difficulty is far lower, so your odds of solving a block are much better, but the block reward is worth a lot less in dollars. Harlo OS takes any SHA-256 pool or solo address, so you can point it at BCH and switch back whenever.
sounds good have a good day
You too, Gabe. Ships October 31, tracking comes to your email. Shout if you want a hand setting the pool up when it lands.
will do i think im going to go with NexusPool
Good choice, plenty of folks run that one. Drop the stratum URL, worker and password into Harlo OS settings and you're mining. Enjoy it.
Take care, Gabe. Happy hashing.
